steps.name: full-check-then-new-debug-APK-for-thermometer-confirm
steps.command:
set -eu
git fetch origin work/ux-evolution
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$(git rev-parse origin/work/ux-evolution)"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
echo "SOURCE_HEAD=$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
echo 'FULL_PNPM_CHECK'
pnpm check >/tmp/shelly-ionic-20261011-195-check.log 2>&1 || {
 echo FULL_CHECK_FAILED
 grep -E 'FAIL|Error|Test Files|Tests |budget' /tmp/shelly-ionic-20261011-195-check.log | tail -85 || true
 tail -90 /tmp/shelly-ionic-20261011-195-check.log
 exit 41
}
echo CHECK_PASSED
grep -E 'Test Files|Tests |Performance budget|Performance review|threshold exceeded|budget passed' /tmp/shelly-ionic-20261011-195-check.log | tail -55 || true
echo 'ANDROID_BUILD'
pnpm --filter @lcl/mobile exec cap sync android
SDK="${ANDROID_SDK_ROOT:-${ANDROID_HOME:-$HOME/Library/Android/sdk}}"
printf 'sdk.dir=%s\n' "$SDK" > apps/mobile/android/local.properties
(cd apps/mobile/android && ./gradlew assembleDebug --quiet)
APK=apps/mobile/android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk
test -s "$APK"
echo "APK_HASH=$(shasum -a 256 "$APK" | awk '{print $1}')"
echo "APK_BYTES=$(wc -c < "$APK" | tr -d ' ')"
echo NATIVE_COUNTER
python3 - <<'PY'
import re
from pathlib import Path
k={'button':0,'input':0,'select':0,'textarea':0};files=set()
for p in Path('apps/mobile/src').rglob('*.tsx'):
 if re.search(r'\.(?:test|spec)\.tsx$',p.name):continue
 s=p.read_text()
 for tag in k:
  n=len(re.findall('<'+tag+r'\b',s))
  k[tag]+=n
  if n:files.add(str(p))
print('COUNTS',k,'TOTAL',sum(k.values()),'FILES',len(files))
PY
echo 'FINAL_STATUS';git status --short
